summary: Agree. We made diversity and inclusion major goals of #IndieWeb. The Code of Conduct enforcement is talen seriously. We had a 60/40 split on keynote speakers so this has gotten better with work to do. We have a travel fund for underrepresented folks.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Agree. We made diversity and inclusion major goals of #IndieWeb. The Code of Conduct enforcement is talen seriously. We had a 60/40 split on keynote speakers so this has gotten better with work to do. We have a travel fund for underrepresented folks.
